independent_linux_controls.assertions: Seven additions; all five original product byte streams and all preexisting overlay mappings unchanged; helper package remains an empty discovery directory.
No new overlay or helper directory created.
Original overlay retained; no new overlay or helper directory created.
Existing output sentinel bytes retained; no helper directory created.

reviewed_invariants: Instrumentation is test compile overlay only. Original guarded Storage.AddAll remains exactly once with original context, prepared change bytes, heads, snapshot and returned error.
Before/after durable gates are within the original final ACL read hold. Original ACL unlock, durable witness and target/settings release remain in their original order.
Capture uses its own short-lived mutexes and channels. It invokes no application callback, replaces no context or identity, returns no native outcome and acquires/releases no native lock.
Observer waits are bounded to twenty seconds, owner waits to fifteen; expected exact event sequence/counts and zero gate timeouts are required. Cleanup releases each gate once.
Block deletion uses actual generated BlockListDelete and original cache.Do[basic.Unlinkable]. Observer requires the exact previously loaded SmartBlock pointer and object ID.

AccountStop uses the original cancelStart behavior and real Service writer lock. Same live Service identity is checked against the successful native application lease. Controller performs no GetApp/cache preload while that writer is queued.

Generated append/delete/stop request bytes are marshaled once before their goroutine and forwarded once to original generated functions. No concurrent use of the existing non-thread-safe RPC count map or testing Fatal in those goroutines is introduced.
First-add loser requires TARGET_UNAVAILABLE with nil receipt and original ErrUnknownTreeId plus nil storage after real block deletion.

Commit-winning deletion requires exact old raw history preservation, one new signed entry with heads bound to the unchanged CREATED receipt, later read/retry TARGET_UNAVAILABLE with nil results, and identical raw history afterward.

Commit-winning AccountStop requires exact old raw preservation at the durable boundary, native return before writer acquisition, successful original Stop, and later generated read/retry NOT_LOGGED_IN with nil results.

scope_limits.toolchain: No local Go toolchain; author used the existing Windows gofmt through bounded stdin/stdout without candidate source writes. Native compilation remains NOT_RUN.

source_findings_resolved.finding: AccountStop case originally counted three entries without proving both preexisting raw changes remained unchanged.
source_findings_resolved.resolution: Fixture now captures original two raw hashes and seeded head, compares each original hash at the durable barrier, and retains the before map/heads in its receipt.

source_findings_resolved.finding: Native return while app lease is held must be distinguished from later generated-byte response conversion/encoding.
source_findings_resolved.resolution: README explicitly allows AccountStop writer acquisition after the native handler releases its lease and before final response-byte encoding completes.

source_findings_resolved.finding: Case 2 README originally implied deletion lock acquisition after the CREATED receipt returns, beyond its actual trace.
source_findings_resolved.resolution: Final README requires deletion acquisition after durable AddAll and both successful results; no append/deletion response ordering is claimed.
